description: This file defines the SmartyCompilerException class, which extends the SmartyException class and represents exceptions specific to the Smarty compiler. It includes methods and properties for error message formatting and storing error context information.

classes.name: SmartyCompilerException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling compiler-specific errors in Smarty templates.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the exception, including the message.
